description: A 360 × 360 metre interpretation of North Beach, traced from 2024 NAIP and audited against official park, art and street records. The 2023 USGS bare-earth DEM supplies a 5 m terrain grid; mapped OpenStreetMap footways add explicit circulation. Structured facts distinguish sourced measurements, observations, estimates and unknowns. The 2022 NOAA reference offers finer detail at an older date. Foundations are modeled supports, not measured floor elevations. This is a spatial sketch, not a measured survey.
